name: Grand Lumiere Cinema
description: Grand Lumiere Cinema is a modern premium cinema in Astana with IMAX technology, Dolby Atmos sound and VIP seating. It is popular among students and families because of comfortable halls, online booking and a large snack zone.

friendReviews.comment: Watched Dune here yesterday. The IMAX hall was amazing and the sound was super clean.
Seats were comfortable, snacks were fresh, and the ticket booking was fast.
Pretty good place for weekend movies. VIP hall is expensive but looks realistic for a premium cinema.

items.name: Dune: Part Two (IMAX)
items.description: Epic sci-fi adventure in premium IMAX format with powerful sound and large-screen visuals.

items.name: Oppenheimer (Dolby)
items.description: Biographical thriller presented in Dolby Atmos for a sharper and more immersive experience.

items.name: Inside Out 2 (Family)
items.description: Popular family animation with comfortable seating and discounted student tickets.
